Signed on verso in graphite pencil [probably near the time of the first sale in 1984]. 
(Source: MFA Boston, 2025)

materials.content:
Watercolor and graphite on moderately thick, white, slightly textured laid paper; Watermark: Arches FRANCE with blind stamp, VERITABLE PAPIER D'ARCHES FIN
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance:
The artist; to Gerald Peters Gallery (Sante Fe), 1984; to private collection (Washington, DC), 1984; with Gerald Peters Gallery (New York); from whom purchased by MFA, 20 September 2006. 
(Source: MFA Boston, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Typed label on backing indicates work signed on verso [not verified]. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A tall set of brown hills rises above an expanse of flat desert dotted with green trees. A deep blue mesa stands behind the hills.
title: Untitled (Ghost Ranch Landscape)
